depicts: Desktop screenshot of a password-correlation tool: two text fields with annotated colored letters and arrows over a blurred, darkened desktop background with a top status bar.
text_readable: Readable: "Green86Boot!", "Boot19Green86!", "This pattern occurs in both the username and password!", "No correlation". Small status-bar text at top ("2 KB/s", "Muted", "06:55 PM") is tiny and only partly legible.
composition: Annotation diagram centred, occupying most of the frame; two strings at top-centre with vertical lines down to captions. Corners and lower sides hold blurred background; captions touch the bottom edge.
tone_and_contrast: Dark teal-grey background with low contrast; yellow, red, blue and green text stands out against it. Red/magenta captions are dimmer than the yellow and green ones.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Background is blurred and dimmed. Text edges are clean at native size. Status bar with system icons and clock is baked in at top; a thin light window border runs around the frame. Mild webp softness on thin lines.
scan_first_read: A password-analysis diagram with colour-coded letters and arrows; the two passwords are readable, the meaning of the colours takes longer to grasp.
